findings.current: He wanted my autograph. And he was a king, no less.
findings.defect: The draft recasts an explicit request as a private desire and makes the follow-up unnecessarily clunky.
findings.rationale: 해 달란다 reports that the king is asking Taekyung to do something, not merely that he wants it.
findings.replacement: He was asking me for an autograph. A king, no less.
findings.source: 나한테 사인을 해 달란다. 그것도 왕이.

findings.current: Hidden beneath his archaic, historical-drama way of speaking was an unmistakable eagerness.
findings.defect: “Eagerness” weakens 간절함, which conveys an urgent, almost desperate desire that the child is trying to conceal.
findings.rationale: The following fidgeting is offered as evidence of Zhu Bao’s concealed 간절함, making the intensity and attempted concealment meaningful characterization.
findings.replacement: Hidden beneath his archaic, historical-drama way of speaking was a desperate eagerness he was trying to conceal.
findings.source: 사극에서나 나올 법한 고풍스러운 말투 속에는 보이지 않는 간절함이 숨겨져 있다.

findings.current: *When things seem impossible, try rummaging through your Inventory. You might find an elixir that’ll shave half a jiazi off your training time, or a weapon made of Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron.*
findings.defect: The draft invents a training-time reduction mechanism. The source describes the elixir itself as being worth half a jiazi.
findings.rationale: 반 갑자짜리 영약 does not say that the elixir shortens training by half a jiazi; converting its stated value into a different mechanical effect is unsupported.
findings.replacement: *When things seem impossible, try rummaging through your Inventory. You might find an elixir worth half a jiazi or a weapon made of Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron.*
findings.source: 도저히 안 되겠다 싶을 때는 인벤토리를 뒤져 보세요. 반 갑자짜리 영약과 만년한철 무기가 나올 수도 있으니까요.

findings.current: Every time I fought, I nearly forgot whether human lives were worth more than the lives of flies.
findings.defect: The draft changes Taekyung’s complaint about his own life feeling as disposable as a fly’s into an abstract comparison of the relative value of human and fly lives.
findings.rationale: 이게 refers to Taekyung’s precarious life in each battle; the joke is that he can no longer tell whether his own life is a human life or a fly’s life.
findings.replacement: Every fight left me wondering whether I had a human life or a fly’s.
findings.source: 한 번씩 싸울 때마다 이게 사람 목숨인지 파리 목숨인지 헷갈릴 정도다.

findings.current: His reactions were so generous that talking to him was a pleasure.
findings.defect: “Reactions were so generous” is an unnatural English collocation and obscures the sense that Zhu Bao’s gratifying responses make Taekyung want to keep talking.
findings.rationale: 리액션이 혜자다 colloquially describes reactions that are exceptionally rewarding or satisfying, while 말할 맛이 난다 means they make speaking enjoyable.
findings.replacement: He gave such great reactions that it made me want to keep talking.
findings.source: 리액션이 혜자다 보니 말할 맛이 난다.

findings.current: Neither group was exactly someone I wanted to join.
findings.defect: The sentence is grammatically mismatched: a group cannot be “someone,” and Taekyung is deciding whether to join their company or conversation.
findings.rationale: The source dismisses both available groups as unappealing company, without changing either group into a singular person.
findings.replacement: Neither the former nor the latter made for company I particularly wanted to join.
findings.source: 전자와 후자, 둘 다 딱히 끼어들고 싶은 대화 상대는 아니다.

findings.current: Hong Jin had been pouting his lips as though he were offended, but then he spoke.
findings.defect: The draft loses 척, which explicitly says Hong Jin is pretending to sulk rather than genuinely appearing offended.
findings.rationale: The deliberate pretense reinforces Hong Jin’s socially manipulative, teasing manner.
findings.replacement: Hong Jin, who had been pretending to sulk with his lips stuck out, spoke.
findings.source: 섭섭한 척 입술을 삐죽 내밀고 있던 홍진이 입을 열었다.

findings.current: When he finished speaking, Hong Jin shot Li Feng a sideways glance.
findings.defect: A neutral “sideways glance” omits the reproach or irritation conveyed by 눈을 흘겼다.
findings.rationale: Hong Jin is pointedly blaming Li Feng for having concealed the Sword Saint and Cheongpung, so the look is accusatory rather than merely lateral.
findings.replacement: When he finished speaking, Hong Jin shot Li Feng a reproachful look.
findings.source: 말을 끝낸 홍진이 이풍을 향해 눈을 흘겼다.

findings.current: I drained my cup of liquor with an embarrassed expression, and my eyes met those of the Four Gates scions sitting at the far end of a table some distance away. They looked as though they were about to suffer indigestion.
findings.defect: 사인방 means a group of four people, but “the Four Gates scions” turns it into an organizational label and falsely implies that they represent four Gates.
findings.rationale: The source identifies the people by their quantity, not as scions belonging to an entity called the Four Gates.
findings.replacement: I drained my cup of liquor with an embarrassed expression, and my eyes met the four of them sitting at the far end of a table some distance away, all looking as though they were about to get indigestion.
findings.source: 무안한 얼굴로 술잔을 쭉 들이켜는데, 한참 떨어진 탁자 끝자리에서 체할 것 같은 얼굴로 앉아 있는 사인방과 시선이 딱 마주쳤다.

findings.defect: Omitting “Comrade” erases the joke created by Taekyung first addressing Hong Jin as 위원장 동지, a Communist-style “Comrade Chairman,” before correcting himself to the similar-sounding official title.
findings.rationale: The humor and self-correction depend on preserving 동지 in the mistaken form of address.

summary: One critical group-identity error and several meaningful losses involving mechanism, characterization, hierarchy, and humor.
